review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen original specification. REQ-001 and AC-001–AC-003 preserve the specified exact-key, live-map counting semantics and compatibility constraints. The binding scope contains the implementation/interface owner and both regression owners without requiring unnecessary edits. Supplied repository configuration and fixed upstream build evidence support treating index.d.ts and dist as generated outputs, with rebuilding required before root-entry runtime and type checks. TASK-IMPLEMENT and dependent, independent TASK-VERIFY match the PRD. Their designated agents have active project-scoped trusted claims supporting the bounded API, TypeScript, shared-data/state and testing responsibilities; pending legacy claims and personas are not needed to establish eligibility. An independent active reviewer is configured for the state/data review prerequisite. No material unresolved decision is supplied for this case, so ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate. Repository identity, stable keys, evidence stages and release-input fingerprints agree across the supplied records. The documented normalization and distinct source-digest domains explain the differing PRD and manifest fingerprints. Model, policy, sampling and budget identifiers are frozen consistently. This assessment uses only the supplied pre-candidate evidence and Service-reported mechanical bindings; I did not recompute digests, execute code, attest human facts or assume successful builds/tests. Approval concerns Gold coherence, not task dispatch or implementation completion.
